diagram_name: Gross Negligence Decline — Exception Path EX-001
description: Customer reports APP fraud. Investigation finds strong evidence of gross negligence: explicit fraud warning overridden, CoP no_match overridden with no vulnerability factors, and contradictory statements from customer. Senior Manager (PER-059) must co-sign the decline decision. Regulated outcome letter issued within 5 business days with FOS signpost. No reimbursement credit. Case closed with evidence of decline archived.

steps.label: Customer reports fraud via mobile app
POST /fraud-cases (trigger_type=customer_report, fraud_typology=impersonation_bank)
Create FraudCase (status=open). Publish FraudCaseCreated (EVT-090)
Dispatch case confirmation to PER-001
GET /fraud-cases/{id} — assigned from queue
Publish FraudDataRequested (payment_intent_id) → Event Bus [cross-capability async: CAP-004→CAP-001]
steps.note: Cross-capability boundary: SVC-013 (CAP-004) must not call SVC-001 (CAP-001) synchronously. Async event-request/response via Event Bus (SVC-102).

steps.label: SVC-001 consumes FraudDataRequested — retrieves PaymentIntent
Publish FraudDataProvided (amount=£28,000, cop_result=no_match, cop_override_confirmed=true, cop_override_timestamp=2026-04-10T14:23:07Z, fraud_risk_level=high)
steps.note: cop_result=no_match AND cop_override_confirmed=true is a key gross negligence indicator

steps.label: SVC-013 consumes FraudDataProvided — PaymentIntent data available for case investigation
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=cop_result — no_match overridden, psr_relevance=supports_gross_negligence)
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=investigating). Publish FraudInvestigationStarted (EVT-091)
Publish FraudWarningLogRequested (payment_intent_id) → Event Bus [cross-capability async: CAP-004→CAP-001]
SVC-001 consumes FraudWarningLogRequested — retrieves payment_warning_log for the payment session
Publish FraudWarningLogProvided: (1) CoP no_match warning displayed + acknowledged 14:23:05Z; (2) Fraud warning modal 'Continue anyway' clicked 14:23:07Z; (3) High-risk confirmation 14:23:12Z
SVC-013 consumes FraudWarningLogProvided — warning log data available as gross negligence evidence
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=payment_warning_log — all three warnings acknowledged, psr_relevance=supports_gross_negligence)
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (vulnerability_assessment=[none_identified])
POST /fraud-cases/{id}/evidence (evidence_type=communication_log — customer's second statement contradicts first; original claim that cop_result=match is refuted by evidence)

steps.note: Analyst assessment: gross negligence established. Customer ignored three explicit warnings. CoP no_match overridden. No vulnerability factors. Reimbursement_amount = £28,000 > £25,000 — escalation to PER-059 required regardless.
steps.label: PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=decision_pending)
Escalate to Senior Manager: case escalated for mandatory co-sign (decline AND value > £25,000). Evidence package provided.
GET /fraud-cases/{id} — review full case and evidence
FraudCase + FraudEvidence records returned. CoP log, warning acknowledgements, vulnerability assessment all visible.
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (senior_manager_sign_off=true, senior_manager_id={manager_id})

POST /fraud-cases/{id}/decision (decision=decline, reimbursement_amount=0, decision_rationale='...', gross_negligence_evidence='Customer explicitly acknowledged CoP no_match warning modal at 14:23:05Z and fraud warning modal at 14:23:07Z. No vulnerability factors. PSR gross negligence standard met.', senior_manager_sign_off=true, senior_manager_id={manager_id})

Validate: senior_manager_sign_off=true confirmed. Update FraudCase (status=declined, decision_outcome=declined, gross_negligence_evidence stored encrypted). Publish FraudReimbursementDeclined (EVT-093)
Dispatch regulated outcome letter (decline) to PER-001 — email mandatory: plain English explanation of gross negligence, FOS signpost, 6-month FOS complaint window
Email: Outcome letter. Decision: not eligible for reimbursement. Reason: [plain language]. Right to complain to FOS within 6 months.
steps.note: Consumer Duty: outcome letter must not deter a legitimate FOS complaint. FOS contact details and PSR consumer guide link included.
No ReimbursementCredited event. No ReimbursementClaim created. SVC-001 and SVC-009 do NOT consume FraudReimbursementDeclined for payment actions.
steps.label: SVC-001 receives EVT-093 (FraudReimbursementDeclined) — no credit action. Optional: update customer account flag for monitoring purposes only.
PATCH /fraud-cases/{id} (status=closed)
Set closed_at. Publish FraudCaseClosed (EVT-097). Publish FraudPatternDetected (EVT-098) — pattern: warning-overriding behaviour. PSR quarterly counter: declined case recorded.
Archive full FraudCase record (including gross_negligence_evidence) to WORM store. 7-year retention. Evidence must be producible for FOS review if customer complains.

regulatory_notes: PSR PS23/3: gross negligence is a high bar — bank bears burden of proof.
Evidence package must be sufficient to defend a FOS complaint. FOS upholds approximately 50% of APP fraud decline complaints reviewed — evidence quality is critical.
Senior Manager (PER-059) mandatory co-sign for all declines — this is an internal control, not a PSR requirement, but it reduces FOS escalation risk.
Outcome letter must be dispatched within 5 business days of original report — even for declined cases.
WORM retention ensures evidence survives the 6-month FOS complaint window and any subsequent FOS investigation.
